from.place: Step 1: projectivity of the extremally disconnected compact target supplies a continuous section.

title: Continuous section of a surjection onto an extremally disconnected compact space
statement: Let α and β be compact Hausdorff topological spaces, with α extremally disconnected. Every continuous surjection f : β → α admits a continuous section ρ : α → β.

source.place: Tag 09AZ, proof of (3) implies (1), paragraph invoking projectivity of an extremally disconnected compact space

proof.text: Apply the projectivity theorem for compact Hausdorff extremally disconnected spaces to the identity map of α and the continuous surjection f. The theorem is universe-polymorphic in the source and target spaces, so it gives a continuous section ρ with f ∘ ρ = id.
